question: In March 2025, 'Lakhpati Didi Sammelan' was held in the state of______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **'Lakhpati Didi Sammelan'** was held in **March 2025** in the state of **Gujarat**. It is a unique initiative to celebrate and empower women entrepreneurs in rural areas.
 
• The event was organized under the **Mission Mangalam initiative**, a flagship program of the Gujarat government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-reliance among women.
 
• The **Lakhpati Didis** are women who have achieved financial independence and earn at least **Rs. 1 lakh annually** through various entrepreneurial ventures and self-help groups (SHGs).
 
• This program is a part of the larger framework of boosting **economic empowerment and rural development** in Gujarat.
 
• The event showcased success stories of women who transformed their lives through entrepreneurship, emphasizing **sustainable growth and financial literacy**.
